methods.outcome: Action 2 divided by actions 1 and 2 in the filtered cohort. All rates are proportions unless labeled pp.
methods.small_cells: Rates with n below 100 are flagged. The adjusted diagnostics export omits segments with fewer than 50 own or peer records. Wilson intervals are descriptive binomial intervals and omit lender and market dependence.
methods.standardization: For each lender within geography × market × product, weight its own and other lenders' observed stratum rates by the same pooled market/product case-mix weights. Restrict and renormalize those weights to strata with at least one record on each side. Support shares refer to the unrenormalized counts. Adjusted gaps are descriptive, and support sets can differ between lenders.
methods.price_metric: Difference in valid originated-loan mean rate spread between the lender and all other lenders in its market and product. Means are record-weighted. Price reflects originated records, while the primary fallout outcome uses all approvals.
methods.price_coverage_gate: Treat matched price evidence as a limited extension when either action has under 50% valid pricing or their nationwide coverage gap exceeds 20 percentage points. This threshold is an analysis rule, not evidence that reporting is random when passed.
methods.matched_price: Subtract the originated median spread from the approved-not-accepted median within each lender × market × product with at least 10 valid prices per action. Summary averages weight each contrast by the smaller of its two priced counts. Gaps remain conditional on reported prices.
methods.primary_eligibility: Own and peer n at least 100 each, reference case-mix support at least 60%, and own and peer originated price coverage at least 50% with at least 30 valid originated prices each. A candidate has a strictly positive price gap and a strictly positive adjusted fallout gap. This is an exploratory screen, not a significance test.
methods.association: Unweighted Spearman rank correlation across eligible lender–market–product segments. This segment-level association is descriptive and differs from a borrower-level price effect.
methods.geography: County and MSA/metro division estimates use their respective observed geographic codes. In the candidate table, geographies=2 means the lender and product were flagged in at least one market at both geographic levels.
methods.material_gap_sensitivity: Uses the primary eligibility rules and retains segments at least 10 basis points above peer originated rate spread and at least 1 percentage point above adjusted peer fallout. These are exploratory size thresholds.
methods.price_available_sensitivity: Uses only valid price records for the outcome, and recalculates support and reference weights within that subset. Originated-loan relative price is unchanged.
